comparison.objective: Install and secure a rack rail versus center a gasket and place four loose bolts through flange holes.
comparison.physical_skill: Handed long-part handling, spring-prong latching, telescoping and threaded fastening versus sequencing a flexible gasket around bolt obstacles and placing bolts.
comparison.success_condition: Rail retained at matching rack units with fully extended springs and bottom-hole screws versus flat centered gasket and four upright inserted bolts.
comparison.reason: Hole alignment is generic; the candidate uniquely requires two-post load-bearing latch retention and screw tightening. Candidate thread and force tolerances remain unspecified.
